import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int v, r;
        long f, c, p;
    }

    static class Flow {
        static int N = 50 * 99 + 2;
        static Edge[] adj = new Edge[N];
        static int[] sz = new int[N];
        static long mc;

        static void init(int n) {
            mc = 0;
            Arrays.fill(sz, 0);
            Arrays.fill(adj, new Edge());
        }

        static void add_edge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
            mc = Math.max(mc, c);
            adj[a].add(new Edge(b, sz[b]++, 0, c, p));
            adj[b].add(new Edge(a, sz[a]++, 0, 0, -p));
        }

        static boolean[] vis = new boolean[N];
        static int[] par = new int[N];
        static long[] pot = new long[N];
        static long[] dist = new long[N];

        static void pot_init(int n) {
            Arrays.fill(pot, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.c > 0) {
                            pot[e.v] = Math.min(pot[e.v], pot[u] + e.p);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        static long mcf(int s, int t, long& price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            Arrays.fill(vis, false);
            Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            dist[s] = 0;
            if (sparse) {
                Queue<Integer> dk = new LinkedList<>();
                dk.add(s);
                while (!dk.isEmpty()) {
                    int u = dk.poll();
                    if (vis[u]) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    vis[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                            dist[e.v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                            par[e.v] = e.r;
                            dk.add(e.v);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for (int u = s; u != -1; ) {
                    vis[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                            dist[e.v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                            par[e.v] = e.r;
                        }
                    }
                    u = -1;
                    long best = Long.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        if (!vis[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                            best = dist[u = i];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] >= Long.MAX_VALUE) {
                return 0;
            }
            long df = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
                Edge r = adj[u][par[u]];
                df = Math.min(df, adj[r.v][r.r].c - adj[r.v][r.r].f);
                u = r.v;
            }
            for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
                Edge r = adj[u][par[u]], e = adj[r.v][r.r];
                e.f += df;
                r.f -= df;
                price += df * e.p;
                u = r.v;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                pot[i] = Math.min(Long.MAX_VALUE, dist[i] + pot[i]);
            }
            return df;
        }

        static long min_cost_flow(int s, int t, long& price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            pot_init(n);
            long flow = price = 0;
            while (long df = mcf(s, t, price, n, sparse)) {
                flow += df;
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int source = 0;
        int sink = n * 99 + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            Flow.add_edge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int t = 0; t < 99; t++) {
            Flow.add_edge(1 + t * n, sink, Long.MAX_VALUE, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    Flow.add_edge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, Long.MAX_VALUE, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < 99; t++) {
                    Flow.add_edge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    Flow.add_edge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long price, flow = Flow.min_cost_flow(source, sink, price, sink + 1, true);
        assert (flow == k);
        pw.println(price);

        pw.close();
    }
}
